text.en:
Subject to the approval of the majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be held in the
Municipality of Balabagan, Province of Lanao del Sur, the barangays of Kapatagan, Riarik, Pinantao,
Sigpang, Biaklayan, Kabaniakawan, Minimao, Malinday, Upper Plasen, Madaya, Barao, Demagalen, Tugaya,
Tola-Tola, Libya-Sager, Dalomangcop, Katitowan, Bongabong, Salaman, Bakikis, Matimus, Lasac,
Bacongan, Banigan, Lusain, Pantukan, Lulubugan, Yliyana, Tappi, Babagulum, Tabowan, Balikaon,
Linindigan, Murusando, Upper-Egabay, Daguan, Inudaran, and Benito are hereby separated from said
municipality and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality in the same province to be known as
the Municipality of Kapatagan. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in the present site of
Barangay Kapatagan.

The Municipality of Kapatagan shall be bounded as follows:
"The Municipality of Kapatagan shall be bounded on the East by the boundary line between the Province of
Lanao del Sur on the West and the Province of Cotabato on the East from the summit of Mount Bita, the
highest peak south of Butig, thence south and west to Tugapangan Point; thence following the natural course
of the Budas River up to its intersection with the Magolalung Creek and following the natural course of said
creek up to the Butig boundary and following the Butig boundary eastward to point of beginning at the
summit of Mount Bita."
